mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 6.0% signals tightening labor market conditions, which increases corporate hiring costs and inflationary pressure, leading to higher equity risk premiums and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 6.0%, or the average forward return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 950,000 units signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives higher consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 950.0, or the average forward return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals an active monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates for equity valuations and reduces risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the average forward return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and rise in the unemployment rate signals a weakening manufacturing sector and labor market contraction, which triggers a risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when both INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 425,000 million dollars, combined with rising housing starts, signals strong aggregate demand, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when both RSAFS > 425,000 and HOUST > 950.0, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200,000 jobs per month, combined with a declining unemployment rate, signals a labor market overheating, which increases inflation expectations and prompts preemptive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 200.0 and UNRATE < 6.0%, or the joint signal fails to outperform baseline in 3-year rolling walk-forward tests (Rank IC < 0.02).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.5% combined with a stable federal funds rate signals entrenched inflation, which increases the risk of future rate hikes and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 236.5 and FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth below 1.0% annualized, combined with falling industrial production, signals a weakening economy and reduced corporate profitability, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances when both GDPC1 < 1.0% and INDPRO declines, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
